findings.evidence: D-row assertions: reason==Queue_Overflow, count>=1, live-pipe check, per-pipe sum `sum_d += d.count` == p.dropped. Probe (this review): the congested fixture's tick-12 record emits exactly 'D pipe=1 class=1 reason=0 count=2' — the aggregated shape IS exercised, but sum-of-counts == dropped holds equally for two count=1 rows; no uniqueness/count==2 assertion exists; live==replay and byte-identity compare the same build against itself.
findings.detail: P0 record-math pin coverage <100%: the documented stream semantic ('multiple same-kind sheds in one tick sum into one row — the count column is meaningful') can silently change shape. Same class as r1 B1: byte-identity passes on identically-wrong shapes.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert no two rows in rec.drops share (pipe,class,reason), and/or pin the known tick-12 shape (one row: pipe 1, class 1, reason 0, count 2).

findings.title: R2-W1 [still present since round 1, W8]: bundle-replication pin is vacuous for load columns — the record is computed post-drain (tick 20) where both members are all-zero
findings.evidence: Probe (this review, instrumented copy): tick 2-8 both members offered=30 carried=30 util=100 q=[0,1,0]; tick 12 and 20 both members offered=0 carried=0 dropped=0 util=0 q=[0,0,0]. The test computes ONE record after stepping 1..=20, so offered/carried/dropped/util/q equalities compare 0==0; only cap_units==30 discriminates (per-pipe read would give 15).
findings.detail: The W8 fix's load-column half does not bite: a regression making members read per-pipe load stays green. The runtime behavior itself is CORRECT (probe shows identical non-zero replicated loads mid-flight) — it is the pin that is vacuous.
findings.recommended_fix: Compute the record at a mid-flight tick (<=8) or per-tick in the loop; assert identical AND non-zero member loads (offered==30, util==100).

findings.title: R2-W2 [still present since round 1, W10]: CI PP_DEBUG gate compiles only the app — harness/overlay.odin and the overlay-check dispatch compile in no CI step
findings.evidence: ci.yml: 'run: odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin' — the only PP_DEBUG build. harness/overlay.odin is wholly compile-gated (plain harness builds exclude it) and the overlay-check verb dispatch in harness/main.odin:82-93 is when-gated; no CI step builds the harness with the define. The step's own comment says 'two whole files rot silently otherwise' — it covers one of the two.
findings.detail: A render-API rename can rot harness/overlay.odin + the gated dispatch while CI stays green — the exact failure the W10 gate exists to prevent. (Verified compiling locally today.)
findings.recommended_fix: Add one CI step: ODIN_ROOT=tools/raylib-sw/shadow odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true (compiles green locally).

findings.title: R2-W3 [W1 residual]: an empty --stats-out token ("") silently disables telemetry in BOTH CLIs — exit 0, no stream, no diagnostic
findings.evidence: Live run (this review): ./bin/harness run qos_contention --stats-out "" -> RC=0, demo green, NO stream file, no diagnostic. Both parsers use the empty string as the off-sentinel (app: 'app.stats_live = stats_path != ""'; harness: 'if stats_out != ""'), so a present-but-empty token (e.g. --stats-out "$OUT" with OUT unset) bypasses the W1 usage error AND the harness one-demo guard.
findings.detail: Defeats the W1 fix's stated contract ('never silently run telemetry-off') for the empty-token variant. Three lenses independently.
findings.recommended_fix: Track flag_seen separately from the value in both parsers; flag seen + empty token -> usage error, exit 2.

findings.title: R2-W4: the app never frees the default temp arena; the new per-step state_hash (full-state serialization at 20Hz) grows it unboundedly on the telemetry/overlay path
findings.evidence: app/main.odin:250 'h := pp.state_hash(&app.state, ... context.temp_allocator)' inside 'if app.stats_live || app.overlay_on' per stepped tick; grep: zero free_all in app/ (harness/run.odin:422 frees per tick). Odin base/runtime/default_temporary_allocator.odin: 'the default context.temp_allocator is typically called with free_all(context.temp_allocator) once per "frame-loop" to prevent it from "leaking" memory.'
findings.detail: With --stats-out or the overlay on, every stepped tick serializes the full state into an arena nothing ever resets — unbounded growth over a session (the pre-existing per-frame HUD strings are small; the hash buffer is not).
findings.recommended_fix: Call free_all(context.temp_allocator) once per frame in the app loop (after render), matching the runtime's documented pattern and the harness drivers.

findings.title: R2-N1: PR body cites the stale r1-era pause-stream size (555KB); the stream at this sha is 369,452 bytes
findings.evidence: _pr_body.md:93 'boot, pause (5.3 schedule, 555KB), ...' vs this review's run: 'stats pause live == replay (369452 bytes, byte-identical)'. (The 555,483B figure was the r1 sha's stream; the r2 D-row aggregation changed the byte count.)

findings.recommended_fix: Update the parenthetical to 369,452 bytes or drop the size annotation.

findings.title: R2-N2: harness accepts a flag-shaped --stats-out path token and writes a stray file; the app rejects the same argv with exit 2
findings.evidence: Live run (this review): ./bin/harness run qos_contention --stats-out --stats-out -> RC=0, writes a literal file named '--stats-out' (65,626B) in cwd. The app's parse loop re-examines the consumed token and exits 2 on the same shape.
findings.detail: Divergent validation at the shared flag boundary; harness litters cwd, app refuses. Cosmetic but inconsistent.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject a token equal to '--stats-out' or starting with '-' in the harness parser (usage/exit 2), mirroring the app.

findings.title: R2-N3: CI's new PP_DEBUG build writes app-debug.bin, which the .gitignore binary rule (app.bin only) does not cover
findings.evidence: git check-ignore app-debug.bin -> rc=1 (not ignored); .gitignore lists only 'app.bin' under 'local build output — never commit binaries'.
findings.detail: A locally replicated debug build (embedding the §7.6 debug tooling) can be committed accidentally — the ignore rule's intent says never.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the rule to 'app*.bin' (or add app-debug.bin) next to app.bin.

findings.title: R2-N4: dead 'before := len(state.events)' / '_ = before' captures left in two stats_test loops
findings.evidence: Both loops capture 'before := len(state.events)' then explicitly discard '_ = before' — the r2 value-pin rework dropped the per-tick hash use but left the captures.
findings.detail: Copy-paste noise from stats_stream_of (where before slices events for the hash); pure dead code in the new tests.

findings.title: R2-N5: fmt_tmp shim's comment claims 'the render package has no fmt strings'; four sibling render modules already format via fmt.aprintf
findings.evidence: Comment: 'the render package has no fmt strings' — but assist/crisis/forecast/health render modules each call fmt.aprintf directly (grep verified); the shim itself wraps fmt.tprintf.
findings.detail: The comment misstates the package idiom and introduces a second formatting path under a false premise.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the comment, or drop fmt_tmp and call fmt.aprintf(..., allocator = context.temp_allocator) like the siblings.

findings.title: R2-N6: app stats builder + header initialized unconditionally; the justifying comment describes a nil-sb path that never appends
findings.evidence: Comment: 'the overlay appends the same record via stats_emit even without --stats-out' — but the loop passes 'sb := &app.stats_sb if app.stats_live else nil' ('nil builder = overlay without --stats-out: compute-only, no memory growth'), so without --stats-out nothing ever appends; the always-written header (~small alloc) is never freed when stats_live is false.
findings.detail: Comment vs code contradiction plus an always-alloc/conditionally-free asymmetry. Harmless at exit, but the stated reason is false.
findings.recommended_fix: Restore conditional init when stats_live, or delete the incorrect comment sentence.

findings.title: R2-N7: draw_heat_tints discards node_slot's ok and indexes node_pos unvalidated, while pipe_slot's ok IS checked two lines above
findings.evidence: 'sa, _ := pp.node_slot(topo, topo.pipe_a[ps])' then 'topo.node_pos[sa]' — a failed lookup would index with an unvalidated slot; the sibling pipe_slot failure is guarded with continue.
findings.detail: Guard asymmetry in PP_DEBUG-only render code; in practice a live pipe implies valid endpoints.
findings.recommended_fix: Handle both node_slot failures like pipe_slot (continue).

findings.title: R2-N8 [still present since round 1, N11]: --stats-out CLI error paths (exit 2 dangling/duplicate, exit 1 unwritable, one-demo guard) have no automated coverage
findings.evidence: The W1/W2 fixes are exactly the spec I/O matrix error rows; only manual verification (this review ran them) covers them — a regression to silent telemetry-off would pass the suite.
findings.detail: Low-risk parse guards, but they are the flag's whole error surface and the r2 rework's own fixes.
findings.recommended_fix: A harness-level test or script asserting the exit codes; or a PR-body manual-checklist line.

findings.title: R2-N9: no literal pin of the CSV row format or the G-row passthroughs (gen/score/meter) — format regressions pass byte-identity
